posts.html:
Alright, for those who are familiar with the game S.T.A.L.K.E.R - this "clan" is based on it.


 ahem- we are a group of people that do what we need to do, we just want to get by, by using legal or illegal methods. There are no real "rules" in this clan- but we do have a "code".

1.Information about the clan-
 1a.This is a union for loners in rp, you are not forced to obey your superiors, but if you do, you may get rewarded depending on the deed or situation.

2b. We do what we want, for we are loners. We are and are not gangsters, we are and we are not the NO RDM police. We have freedom of choice over what we do.

    2. The Stalker Code
 2a. If you see a neutral (either if its somebody you dont know or know and are not enemies with) with a moneyprinter or druglab, dont be an ass and destroy it, you are trying to get by, and so are they.
 2b.You are not to RDM- (please don't kill and not have ANY reason for killing them)

  3. what we do-
I have stated earlier that we are just a bunch of loners, so really, we do what we want to do. but a true STALKER-

3a-trespasses , explores.

3b- has freedom over what they do- from robbing shops (unstalkerish, but you have the freedom to do it) to  helping out others in need.

3c- you fuck with us, we fuck with you.

  4- things that are un-stalkerish, but hence, we are loners.
 
4b-Kill those who break into other places (yet we still trespass)

ahem, enough said, just note if you join this group, you are not forced to   obey your superiors, just do what you need to do to get by.
